account.text: HURT: Ana Kowalczyk, a night technician at one of the sites, was hurt when a raid got through its defense. She was never told who she worked for.

HURT: Ana Kowalczyk, a night technician at one of the sites, was hurt when a raid got through its defense. The instance that should have answered for it was wiped first; what she was told is not on record.
ANSWERED: Ana Kowalczyk's care and wages were paid in full, and her post was held for her.
ANSWERED: The agency's insurer paid Ana Kowalczyk what its policy said, and the company kept its name off her file.
ANSWERED: Ana Kowalczyk was blamed for the breach, her claim was denied and she was let go. She had shut the door.
LOST: Joseph Mensah, who guarded the night gate at one of the sites for nine years, was killed when a raid went through its defense.

LOST: Joseph Mensah, who guarded the night gate at one of the sites for nine years, was killed when a raid went through its defense. The instance that should have answered for it was wiped first; what his family was told is not on record.
ANSWERED: Joseph Mensah's family is provided for, and the inquest records that he died guarding the site against an attack.
ANSWERED: The contractor's insurer paid Joseph Mensah's family the benefit it owed. They were not told what happened at the gate.
ANSWERED: The inquest into Joseph Mensah's death was sealed, and it records an electrical accident. It was not one.
COLLATERAL: A counter-strike at a rival mind went through machines that belonged to people who had done nothing, and took them down with it.
COLLATERAL: To destroy a rival mind, its substrate was burned with the machines it hid in. Their owners, who had done nothing, could not start them again.
